import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR'].copy()
daily = acc.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum().sort_index()
# need chronological order; parse dates
from datetime import datetime
daily = daily.copy()
daily.index = [datetime.strptime(d, '%m/%d/%y') for d in daily.index]
daily = daily.sort_index()
print(daily.tail(15))
anom = daily['2025-10-20']
print('anomaly day total:', anom)
# baseline: prior 14 days avg
base = daily[daily.index < pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')].tail(14).mean()
print('baseline avg:', base, 'diff:', anom-base)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR'].copy()
acc['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(acc['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
anom_date = '2025-10-20'
a = acc[acc.dt==anom_date]
b = acc[(acc.dt < anom_date) & (acc.dt >= '2025-10-06')]
keys = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
gA = a.groupby(keys)['unblended_cost'].sum()
gB = b.groupby(keys)['unblended_cost'].mean()
comp = pd.concat([gA, gB], axis=1)
comp.columns=['anom','base']
comp['diff']=comp.anom-comp.base
print(comp.sort_values('diff', ascending=False).head(15))
print(comp.sort_values('diff').tail(5))
